sentences.text: Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, 1950 read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as 'B.N.S.S.'), has been filed on behalf of the Petitioner, for direction to the Respondent No. 1, to provide protection to the life and limbs of the Petitioner.
2. It is submitted that the Petitioner since November, 2021, has been taking Coaching for UPSC Competitive Examination at Mukherjee Nagar.
She was able to crack the Preliminary Examination of UPSC, 2023 and also other Examination of I.B. (2021), Railway Group-D.

sentences.text: On 14.02.2025, she lost her struggle at the hands of the Respondent Nos. 2 to 5 and was compelled to marry to the Respondent No. 6 against her consent.
In March, 2025, the Respondent No. 6 and his family members permitted the Petitioner, to pursue her Examination for UPSC to be held on 12.10.2025.
However, on 12.06.2025, she was again forcibly taken back by the Respondent Nos. 2 to 5 in collusion with the Respondent No. 6.
On reaching the parental home in Meerut, she was given brutal beatings.

4. On 14.06.2025, the Petitioner had an opportunity in the night to save her life and reported the matter to Police Station Daurala, Uttar Pradesh, to secure the presence at Mukherjee Nagar Coaching Centre, with a warning to the Respondent Nos. 2 to 6, not to dare cause any harm to the Petitioner.

Feeling imminent apprehension to her life and limbs, she had written a Complaint dated 17.06.2025, to the Respondent No. 1 and the higher officials of Delhi Police but no action has been taken against the Respondent Nos. 2 and 6.
5.

Hence, a Prayer is made that the Respondent Nos. 2 to 6 be directed not to extend any threats and such other appropriate directions, as being proper, may be made.
6.
The Petitioner has appeared through Video-Conferencing and has submitted that the family members are not letting her pursue her studies.
They had compelled her to write a suicide note to justify the harm that they may cause to her, in case she continued to be persistent towards appearing in various examinations.

Submission heard and the record perused.

8. Considering the submissions made in the Petition, the SHO, Police Station Mukherjee Nagar to provide his mobile number, as well as, of the Beat Constable and also to take rounds to ensure the safety and security of the Petitioner.
9. The Petition is disposed of accordingly.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J JULY 9, 2025/RS
